sloka: सर्वतः च महाभीमाः शीत तोया महाशुभाः ।अगाधा ग्राहवत्यः च परिखा मीन सेविताः ॥६-३-१५॥।।
transliteration: sarvataḥ ca mahābhīmāḥ śīta toyā mahāśubhāḥ ।agādhā grāhavatyaḥ ca parikhā mīna sevitāḥ ॥6-3-15॥।।

translations.english: All round it (boundary wall) are very splendid moats filled with frighteningcold water inhabited by fish and crocodiles.
